reason: Having seen Jamku and desktop ERP get abandoned by my staff after two months, I am not paying ₹12,990 upfront for another system when article clerks rotate every two to three years and training them feels like wasted effort. In a normal week, I would only test the two-seat free pilot to see if it actually cuts my Saturday GST reconciliation without adding training overhead.
objection: My article clerks rotate every 2-3 years; training them on complex software is a waste of time if they end up abandoning it after two months.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a fresh article clerk pick up the statutory blueprints from day one without any training from me, while completely eliminating my two hours of Saturday GST reconciliation.
